dataFlows.transformKql:
source
| extend RawEvent = parse_json(tostring(source))
| extend SourceSystem = 'TOPdesk'
| extend priorityObj = parse_json(tostring(RawEvent['priority']))
| extend impactObj = parse_json(tostring(RawEvent['impact']))
| extend urgencyObj = parse_json(tostring(RawEvent['urgency']))
| extend categoryObj = parse_json(tostring(RawEvent['category']))
| extend subcategoryObj = parse_json(tostring(RawEvent['subcategory']))
| extend callTypeObj = parse_json(tostring(RawEvent['callType']))
| extend callerObj = parse_json(tostring(RawEvent['caller']))
| extend operatorObj = parse_json(tostring(RawEvent['operator']))
| extend operatorGroupObj = parse_json(tostring(RawEvent['operatorGroup']))
| extend IncidentId = tostring(RawEvent['id'])
| extend IncidentNumber = tostring(RawEvent['number'])
| extend Title = tostring(RawEvent['briefDescription'])
| extend Description = tostring(RawEvent['request'])
| extend Status = tostring(RawEvent['status'])
| extend Priority = tostring(priorityObj['name'])
| extend Impact = tostring(impactObj['name'])
| extend Urgency = tostring(urgencyObj['name'])
| extend Category = tostring(categoryObj['name'])
| extend Subcategory = tostring(subcategoryObj['name'])
| extend CallType = tostring(callTypeObj['name'])
| extend CallerId = tostring(callerObj['id'])
| extend CallerName = tostring(callerObj['name'])
| extend OperatorId = tostring(operatorObj['id'])
| extend OperatorName = tostring(operatorObj['name'])
| extend OperatorGroupId = tostring(operatorGroupObj['id'])
| extend OperatorGroupName = tostring(operatorGroupObj['name'])
| extend CreatedDateTime = todatetime(RawEvent['creationDate'])
| extend UpdatedDateTime = todatetime(RawEvent['modificationDate'])
| extend ClosedDateTime = todatetime(RawEvent['closedDate'])
| extend TargetDateTime = todatetime(RawEvent['targetDate'])
| extend Archived = tobool(RawEvent['archived'])
| extend IsPartial = tobool(RawEvent['partial'])
| extend IsFirstLine = tobool(RawEvent['firstLine'])
| extend IsSecondLine = tobool(RawEvent['secondLine'])
| extend TimeGenerated = todatetime(RawEvent['modificationDate'])
| project TimeGenerated, SourceSystem, IncidentId, IncidentNumber, Title, Description, Status, Priority, Impact, Urgency, Category, Subcategory, CallType, CallerId, CallerName, OperatorId, OperatorName, OperatorGroupId, OperatorGroupName, CreatedDateTime, UpdatedDateTime, ClosedDateTime, TargetDateTime, Archived, IsPartial, IsFirstLine, IsSecondLine, RawEvent
